meta.title: SimpleMindsAI Source Expansion Inventory v2
meta.description: Versioned source inventory for a larger controlled corpus experiment. Inventory development only; no acquisition, training or production state is authorised or changed.

notes: Capacity is measured after fetch, quality, deduplication, v1-overlap and cross-source-overlap allowances, then multiplied by an explicit uncertainty factor.
The planned draw is a subset of capacity chosen under publisher, source-family, subject, format and governance caps.
Share-alike and non-commercial sources are excluded from the unrestricted target pool and reported separately.
Publisher diversity and source-family diversity are measured separately; parent/subsidiary/aggregator relationships are grouped.
No source may contribute more than 2% of the planned draw through a single document; long books are deliberately limited by document counts.

sources.title: Project Gutenberg
sources.description: Long-form U.S. public-domain books (literature, history, philosophy, science, reference).

access.urlGenerationRule: Select book IDs from the Gutenberg bookshelf/offline catalog; download plain text from /cache/epub/<id>/pg<id>.txt. Exclude v1 IDs 1342 and 1661 and titles selected from Standard Ebooks.

estimates.basis: Pilot v1 measured 132k-166k tokens for two long novels; 55k is a conservative book average after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Book length varies widely; some texts are multi-volume, dramatic or non-prose; boilerplate/header removal needed.

v1Overlap.method: URL/book-ID exclusion against frozen v1 source IDs and title-level exclusion of the two v1 works.
v1Overlap.limitations: Exact v1 overlap only; other editions of the same work may still overlap.

screening.method: Book-ID/title selection; no bulk fetch in this work package
knownExclusions: Project Gutenberg headers/footers and trademark references
works not clearly U.S. public domain
works already selected from Standard Ebooks

sources.notes: Large headroom; capped to avoid publisher dominance and literary-format dominance.

sources.title: Standard Ebooks
sources.description: Carefully edited U.S. public-domain literature and selected non-fiction, dedicated to the public domain via CC0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate catalogue pages at /ebooks; fetch EPUB/XHTML text from the ebook page. Prefer prose works and exclude titles used by Project Gutenberg.

estimates.basis: Public-domain book-length works; 60k tokens per cleaned book is conservative.
estimates.limitations: Catalogue overlaps Gutenberg source texts; title-level exclusion needed. Strong literary bias.

v1Overlap.method: No frozen-v1 Standard Ebooks source IDs; title-level exclusion of v1 Gutenberg works.
v1Overlap.limitations: Text may derive from the same public-domain edition as a Gutenberg text.

screening.method: Catalogue/title selection; no bulk fetch
knownExclusions: titles already selected from Project Gutenberg
screening.licenseFilter: CC0 dedication stated on each ebook imprint

sources.notes: Editorial work is CC0; underlying text is U.S. public domain. Some v1 books are also available here, so title-level exclusion is mandatory.

sources.title: OAPEN Library (CC BY subset)
sources.description: Peer-reviewed open-access scholarly books from hundreds of publishers; only item-level CC BY books are approved.

access.urlGenerationRule: Harvest OAI-PMH records from https://library.oapen.org/oai/request; retain only records whose licence field is CC BY 4.0 and whose language is English. Download the book PDF/EPUB from the item handle.

estimates.basis: Book-length scholarly monographs; 50k tokens per cleaned book after front/back matter removal.
estimates.limitations: OAPEN is a host/aggregator; underlying publisher diversity is high but must be recorded item by item. Some books are CC BY-NC/ND and must be excluded.

v1Overlap.method: No frozen-v1 OAPEN source IDs; content-family review only.
v1Overlap.limitations: No full-text v1 screening of OAPEN books yet.

screening.method: OAI-PMH/metadata filter on item-level licence; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: item-level dc:rights must contain CC BY 4.0

sources.notes: Underlying publishers are counted from item metadata for publisher-diversity analysis; OAPEN itself is treated as one publisher group. Open Book Publishers is covered within OAPEN and is not counted as a separate source.

sources.title: arXiv (CC BY 4.0 subset)
sources.description: Preprints in mathematics, physics, computer science and engineering; only articles whose arXiv licence is CC BY 4.0 are approved.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use arXiv OAI-PMH/API metadata to select records with licence 'CC BY 4.0'; fetch the PDF/HTML for those records only. Do not mine non-CC-BY records.

estimates.basis: Research articles typically 5k-15k tokens; 8k is a conservative cleaned average. arXiv bulk metadata and PDFs are stable.
estimates.limitations: Licence is per article; the default arXiv licence is not CC BY. LaTeX/PDF extraction can include formulas, references and appendices. Preprints may overlap with published versions.

v1Overlap.method: No frozen-v1 arXiv source IDs; lexical screening still required.

screening.method: OAI-PMH/metadata licence filter; no bulk download
knownExclusions: papers whose PDF extraction fails quality checks
papers duplicated by a publisher source
screening.licenseFilter: arXiv licence metadata must equal CC BY 4.0

sources.notes: The CC BY subset provides large math/physics/CS capacity without relying on Wikipedia or OpenStax.

sources.title: PLOS journals
sources.description: Peer-reviewed open-access science and medicine articles published under CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use PLOS journal search/API or sitemaps to enumerate research articles; fetch the HTML full text. Exclude articles whose DOI is already selected from PMC.

estimates.basis: Research articles typically 4k-10k tokens; 6k conservative after reference removal.
estimates.limitations: PLOS articles are also indexed in PMC; cross-source overlap must be managed. Some articles contain third-party figures/text.

v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened against v1 yet.

screening.method: Journal/API metadata; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Strong medicine/biology capacity; publisher diversity is real but cross-source overlap with PMC is material.

sources.title: eLife
sources.description: Peer-reviewed life-science and biomedical research articles under CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate article URLs from the eLife sitemap; fetch HTML full text. Exclude DOIs selected via PMC.

estimates.basis: Long-form research articles; 8k conservative cleaned tokens.
estimates.limitations: eLife articles are also in PMC; overlap must be managed. Some reviews/editorials are not research articles.

v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened against v1 yet.

screening.method: Journal sitemap/API; no bulk fetch

sources.title: PubMed Central Open Access Subset (CC BY only)
sources.description: Biomedical and life-science full text from the PMC Open Access Subset; only CC BY 4.0 articles are approved.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use PMC Cloud Service, OAI-PMH, E-utilities or BioC API; filter to the OA subset and to articles whose licence is CC BY 4.0. Exclude DOIs already selected from publisher-specific sources.

estimates.basis: PMC OA articles typically 3k-8k tokens; 5k conservative. Retrieval via PMC Cloud/OAI/E-utilities is designed for text mining.
estimates.limitations: PMC is a distributor, not a single publisher. Licence varies per article. A large share of PMC content is also available from PLOS/eLife/Frontiers/BMC/MDPI, so capacity is discounted heavily for cross-source overlap.

v1Overlap.limitations: PMC includes many publishers; v1 could contain the same article through another source.

screening.method: PMC OA service with licence metadata filter; no bulk fetch
knownExclusions: articles from publishers already selected via PLOS/eLife/Frontiers/BMC/MDPI

sources.notes: Heavy cross-source-overlap discount prevents double counting with publisher-specific sources.

sources.title: Frontiers journals
sources.description: Peer-reviewed open-access science, health and engineering articles under CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate articles from journal sitemaps or the Frontiers API; fetch HTML full text. Exclude DOIs selected via PMC.

estimates.basis: Research articles; 6k conservative cleaned tokens.
estimates.limitations: Quality varies across journals; some articles are short or contain third-party material. Overlap with PMC.

v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened against v1 yet.

screening.method: Journal/sitemap metadata; no bulk fetch

sources.title: BMC / SpringerOpen (CC BY subset)
sources.description: Open-access biomedical and life-science articles under CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate articles from BMC/SpringerOpen journal sitemaps; fetch HTML full text. Exclude DOIs selected via PMC.

estimates.basis: Research articles; 6k conservative cleaned tokens.
estimates.limitations: Some SpringerOpen content is CC BY-NC/ND; item-level filtering required. Overlap with PMC.

v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened against v1 yet.

screening.method: Journal/sitemap metadata; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Springer Nature also publishes non-open content; only CC BY items qualify.

sources.title: MDPI (CC BY subset)
sources.description: Open-access science, engineering and medical articles under CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate articles from MDPI journal sitemaps; fetch HTML full text. Prefer substantial research articles and exclude DOIs selected via PMC.

estimates.basis: Research articles; 6k conservative cleaned tokens.
estimates.limitations: Very large and uneven journal portfolio; quality review needed. Some special issues contain short papers. Overlap with PMC.

v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened against v1 yet.

screening.method: Journal/sitemap metadata; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Lower uncertainty factor reflects heterogeneous quality.

sources.title: Copernicus Publications
sources.description: Open-access earth, atmospheric, ocean and environmental science journals under CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate articles from Copernicus journal sitemaps; fetch HTML/PDF full text.

estimates.basis: Research articles; 8k conservative cleaned tokens.
estimates.limitations: Some articles are short; figures/tables and references need cleaning. Author-name/publisher concentration within geoscience.

v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened against v1 yet.

screening.method: Journal sitemap/API; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: One of the strongest unrestricted earth-science sources.

sources.title: U.S. Geological Survey publications
sources.description: USGS-authored reports, fact sheets and scientific information products in earth, water, environmental and natural-hazard science.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use the USGS Publications Warehouse API/catalog to select USGS-authored reports and fact sheets; fetch PDF/HTML.

estimates.basis: USGS reports/fact sheets are often long; 12k tokens conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Some reports include third-party maps/photos; text-only extraction. Publication formats vary (PDF, HTML).

v1Overlap.method: Agency/source-family review; no USGS documents in v1 manifest.

screening.method: USGS Publications Warehouse metadata/API; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Clear public-domain posture with third-party-content caveat.

sources.title: NOAA publications and science pages
sources.description: NOAA-authored ocean, atmosphere, climate, weather and fisheries science content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use the NOAA Institutional Repository/catalog and NOAA science pages; select NOAA-authored reports and long-form pages.

estimates.basis: Mix of reports and web pages; 10k tokens conservative for report-heavy draw.
estimates.limitations: Many NOAA pages are short; repository items vary. Third-party figures and data products need exclusion.

screening.method: NOAA repository/catalog metadata; no bulk fetch

sources.title: NASA science, technical reports and mission content
sources.description: NASA-authored science, mission, aeronautics and space-technology pages and NTRS technical reports.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate NASA science pages and NTRS records; fetch HTML/PDF for NASA-authored text.

estimates.basis: Mix of short web pages and long NTRS reports; 5k conservative average.
estimates.limitations: Web pages are often short; NTRS reports are long but may be contractor-authored. Text-only; exclude images/insignia.

v1Overlap.method: NASA source-family review plus URL exclusion of the 7 v1 NASA pages.

screening.method: NASA science sitemaps + NTRS metadata; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: NTRS adds long-form engineering/space reports; web pages alone have low yield.

sources.title: NIST publications and measurement science
sources.description: NIST-authored standards, measurement-science, cybersecurity and laboratory publications.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate NIST publications from the NIST publications catalog/NVL Pubs; fetch PDF/HTML.

estimates.basis: NIST special publications/handbooks are long; 6k conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: NIST co-publishes journal articles with third parties; only NIST-authored publications qualify. v1 has 3 NIST pages.

v1Overlap.method: NIST source-family review plus URL/title exclusion of the 3 v1 NIST pages.

screening.method: NIST publications catalog/NVL Pubs; no bulk fetch

sources.title: DOE OSTI U.S. Government Work reports
sources.description: DOE/OSTI technical reports and scientific information explicitly marked U.S. Government Work.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use OSTI bibliographic records to select reports marked U.S. Government Work; fetch the public full text.

estimates.basis: DOE technical reports are often long; 12k conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: OSTI hosts copyrighted journal articles and conference proceedings; only explicit U.S. Government Work documents qualify. Unmarked documents are treated as copyrighted.

screening.method: OSTI bibliographic/metadata filter; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Strong engineering/physics capacity after strict filtering.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions (DLMF)
sources.description: NIST-authored mathematical reference with formulas, definitions and chapters.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate DLMF chapters/sections under dlmf.nist.gov; fetch HTML and extract prose.

estimates.basis: DLMF chapters are long; 30k conservative after formula/notation handling.
estimates.limitations: Mathematics is formula-heavy; cleaned prose tokens are lower than raw text. Some chapters include third-party contributions.

screening.method: DLMF chapter index; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Same publisher group as NIST; measured as one publisher for concentration.

sources.title: U.S. National Park Service heritage and natural-resource pages
sources.description: NPS-authored natural and cultural heritage, geology, climate and history content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate NPS subject pages; fetch HTML and clean navigation.

estimates.basis: NPS web pages are often short; 3k conservative.
estimates.limitations: Short pages and navigation; third-party content; quality filtering needed.

screening.method: NPS subject sitemaps; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Adds history/earth breadth, but yield per URL is low.

sources.title: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.description: CDC-authored public-health, epidemiology, prevention and health-communication content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate CDC topic pages and long-form guidance from sitemaps; fetch HTML and clean boilerplate.

estimates.basis: CDC web pages are often short; 3k tokens conservative after boilerplate removal.
estimates.limitations: Many pages are navigation/boilerplate or data tables; quality filtering needed. Some content is third-party or dated.

screening.method: CDC sitemap/topic index; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Useful for public-health vocabulary and practical prose but lower yield per URL.

sources.title: NIH / National Library of Medicine consumer health and reference
sources.description: NLM-authored health reference, MedlinePlus and consumer-health content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate MedlinePlus/NLM topic pages; fetch HTML and clean boilerplate.

estimates.basis: Consumer-health pages; 3k tokens conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Short pages and boilerplate; some linked content is third-party. Avoid duplicating PMC journal articles.

screening.method: NLM sitemap/topic index; no bulk fetch

sources.title: U.S. Department of Agriculture
sources.description: USDA-authored agriculture, nutrition, food science, forestry and environmental content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate USDA agency topic pages and publications; fetch HTML/PDF.

estimates.basis: Mix of short web pages and longer reports; 3.5k conservative.
estimates.limitations: Agency sub-sites vary; third-party content and data tables need exclusion.

screening.method: USDA agency/topic sitemaps; no bulk fetch

sources.title: U.S. Census Bureau
sources.description: Census-authored population, society, economy, housing and geography reference content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate Census topic/program pages; fetch HTML and clean tables/boilerplate.

estimates.basis: Census explanatory pages; 3k tokens conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Many pages are data tables or short definitions; v1 already has 3 Census pages.

v1Overlap.method: Census source-family review plus URL/title exclusion of the v1 Census pages.

screening.method: Census topic/program sitemaps; no bulk fetch

sources.title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
sources.description: BLS-authored labor, employment, inflation and economic reference content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate BLS topic and publication pages; fetch HTML.

estimates.basis: BLS explanatory pages; 3k tokens conservative.
estimates.limitations: Short explanatory pages and statistical tables; quality filtering needed.

screening.method: BLS topic/sitemap pages; no bulk fetch

sources.title: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
sources.description: EPA-authored environmental science, regulation, health and pollution-prevention content.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate EPA topic pages and reports; fetch HTML/PDF.

estimates.basis: EPA pages vary from short guidance to longer reports; 3k conservative.
estimates.limitations: v1 already has one EPA page; third-party content and data tables need exclusion.

v1Overlap.method: EPA source-family review plus URL/title exclusion of the v1 EPA page.

screening.method: EPA topic/sitemap pages; no bulk fetch

sources.title: GOV.UK (Open Government Licence)
sources.description: UK government guidance, policy papers, statistics and public-service publications under OGL v3.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use the GOV.UK Content API/search API to select guidance and publications; fetch HTML and clean navigation/boilerplate.

estimates.basis: Mix of guidance pages and long policy publications; 5k conservative.
estimates.limitations: Some GOV.UK content is short or 404-prone; Crown copyright material not covered by OGL must be excluded. v1 has 5 GOV.UK pages.

v1Overlap.method: GOV.UK source-family review plus URL exclusion of the 5 v1 GOV.UK pages.

screening.method: GOV.UK content API/search; no bulk fetch

sources.title: EUR-Lex and EU Publications Office
sources.description: EU legislation, policy, reports and publications available for reuse under the EU reuse policy/CC BY 4.0.

access.urlGenerationRule: Use EUR-Lex/Publications Office search and OAI/SPARQL endpoints to select English documents with reuse-permitting notices; fetch HTML/PDF.

estimates.basis: EU reports/legislation are often long; 12k conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Third-party content, personal data, logos and some documents are excluded from the reuse decision. Per-item rights check required.

screening.method: EUR-Lex/Publications Office metadata; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: EU reuse decision/CC BY 4.0 stated content only

sources.title: World Bank Open Knowledge Repository (CC BY subset)
sources.description: World Bank formal publications and policy research working papers under CC BY 4.0/3.0 IGO.

access.urlGenerationRule: Harvest OKR OAI-PMH metadata; retain items with CC BY 4.0/3.0 IGO rights and English language. Fetch the PDF from the item handle.

estimates.basis: World Bank reports/books are long; 25k conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Some OKR items are CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-ND; item-level filter required. External-publisher manuscripts may have different terms.

screening.method: OKR OAI-PMH/metadata filter; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: item-level CC BY 4.0 or CC BY 3.0 IGO only

sources.notes: Strong economics/development capacity; item-level filtering is essential.

sources.title: OECD publications
sources.description: OECD reports, policy analysis and statistics under CC BY 4.0 (post-1 July 2024) or equivalent terms.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate OECD publications from oecd.org/oecd-ilibrary; check the copyright page and select CC BY 4.0 or equivalent terms; fetch HTML/PDF.

estimates.basis: OECD reports/books are long; 20k conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Pre-1 July 2024 content is governed by OECD terms (generally CC BY-like but with exceptions). Third-party content must be excluded.

screening.method: OECD publication metadata/terms; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: CC BY 4.0 or equivalent OECD terms, per item

sources.notes: Licence status changed in 2024; per-item verification is mandatory.

sources.title: Our World in Data
sources.description: Data-driven explanatory articles on global health, economics, environment, energy and development.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate OWID article pages; fetch HTML and keep OWID-authored prose, excluding embedded third-party charts/data.

estimates.basis: OWID articles are moderate-length; 3k conservative after cleaning.
estimates.limitations: Some charts/data are third-party; only OWID-authored article text is approved. Short entries and data pages need filtering.

screening.method: OWID sitemap/article index; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: OWID-authored article text under CC BY

sources.title: Open Logic Project
sources.description: Open-source logic and formal-reasoning textbooks and chapters.

access.urlGenerationRule: Select book/part PDFs or HTML from the Open Logic Project catalogue; exclude duplicate remixes and works already covered by forall x.

estimates.basis: Book-length logic texts; 70k conservative.
estimates.limitations: PDF/LaTeX extraction; mathematical notation is not natural-language prose. Multiple remixes/editions overlap.

screening.method: Project catalogue/GitHub releases; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: CC BY 4.0 stated on the work

sources.notes: Same publisher group as forall x; measured as one publisher for concentration.

sources.title: forall x: Calgary
sources.description: Full-featured open introduction to formal logic, with exercises and solutions.

access.urlGenerationRule: Select distinct editions from forallx.openlogicproject.org (PDF and HTML); avoid duplicate revisions.

estimates.basis: Book-length logic text; 90k conservative across editions.
estimates.limitations: Multiple editions/revisions overlap heavily; select one or a few distinct editions. PDF/HTML extraction of notation.

screening.method: Project catalogue; no bulk fetch
screening.licenseFilter: CC BY 4.0 stated on the work

sources.notes: Related to Open Logic Project; grouped under open-logic-project for publisher concentration.

sources.title: Python documentation
sources.description: Official Python language, standard-library and tutorial documentation.

access.urlGenerationRule: Enumerate docs.python.org/3 tutorial/library/reference pages; exclude v1 URLs and select prose-rich pages.

estimates.basis: Pilot v2 measured ~7.4k tokens per accepted Python docs page; 5k is conservative.
estimates.limitations: v1 already has 24 Python documentation pages; select new pages and screen. Code-heavy pages have lower prose ratio.

v1Overlap.method: Python source-family review plus URL exclusion of the 24 v1 Python docs pages.
v1Overlap.limitations: Not full-text screened yet; some pages may be re-fetched under different anchors.

screening.method: Documentation index/sitemap; no bulk fetch
screening.representativeSample: pilot v2 measured 29 accepted Python docs pages

screening.method: Documentation index/sitemap; no bulk fetch

sources.notes: Rust source may be dual MIT/Apache-2.0; MIT is recorded as the permissive option.

uncertainties.detail: Whether training a model on licensed text, and distributing model weights, constitutes adaptation or derivative use is jurisdiction-dependent and not settled for every licence.
uncertainties.action: Obtain legal review before using share-alike or non-commercial material.

uncertainties.detail: OpenStax current editions, MIT OpenCourseWare, Khan Academy, WHO and FAO are non-commercial. A model that may later be used commercially is not safely within that scope without permission.
uncertainties.action: Keep out of the unrestricted pool; seek permission or a commercial-use licence if needed.

uncertainties.detail: OpenStax changed its current library to CC BY-NC-SA in 2026. Other publishers may change terms; the inventory records the terms observed on 2026-11-02.
uncertainties.action: Re-verify licences immediately before acquisition and freeze evidence hashes.

uncertainties.topic: Third-party content inside government and institutional publications
uncertainties.detail: USGS, NOAA, NASA, NIST, OSTI, CDC, NIH, USDA, Census, BLS, EPA, GOV.UK and EU publications may embed third-party text, figures, maps or journal articles that are not covered by the government/institutional licence.
uncertainties.action: Text-only extraction; exclude third-party material; item-level rights review before acquisition.

uncertainties.detail: PMC overlaps with PLOS, eLife, Frontiers, BMC/SpringerOpen and MDPI. Standard Ebooks often derives from Project Gutenberg texts. The capacity model applies explicit discounts, but actual overlap is not yet measured.
uncertainties.action: Measure DOI/title overlap in a bounded acquisition pilot before final composition.

uncertainties.detail: Token estimates use pilot measurements for some sources and conservative document-length assumptions for others. New sources have not been sampled at scale.
uncertainties.action: Run a bounded acquisition pilot and measure actual cleaned-token yield per source.

uncertainties.detail: OAPEN, EU, OECD, World Bank and some agency sources contain non-English documents. Estimates assume English-only filtering with a confidence threshold.
uncertainties.action: Apply the production language policy and record rejection rates.

uncertainties.topic: Robots, rate limits and access terms
uncertainties.detail: Bulk retrieval terms differ by source; some require APIs, OAI-PMH or prior permission. This work package performed no bulk acquisition.
uncertainties.action: Complete robots/terms review per source before acquisition; honour rate limits and required user agents.

uncertainties.detail: Lexical MinHash/Jaccard screening cannot reliably detect translations, substantial paraphrases or rewrites. Semantic duplication may remain.
uncertainties.action: Retain lexical dedup plus manual/semantic review for high-risk families.

uncertainties.detail: Known v1 overlap is recorded at source/title level for most families; full-text screening of the expanded inventory has not been performed.
uncertainties.action: Run full v1 exact/normalised/MinHash screening during the separately authorised acquisition pilot.

uncertainties.detail: OAPEN and PMC are distributors with many underlying publishers. Publisher-diversity analysis must use item-level metadata, not just the distributor name.
uncertainties.action: Extract underlying publisher metadata during acquisition and re-run concentration analysis.

uncertainties.detail: Licence pages and terms were reviewed by research on 2026-11-02; some pages could not be fetched or may change. No legal clearance is claimed.
uncertainties.action: Freeze licence-page evidence hashes immediately before acquisition; obtain legal review for flagged items.
